pages.title: Week #1
pages.text: WEEK #1 MAIN FOCUS: GENERAL PREPARATION PHASE (FOUNDATION BUILDING) Purpose: This phase is all about laying a strong foundation for your boxing performance. The goal is to build overall physical fitness, reinforce fundamental techniques, and develop the mental discipline required for high-level training. Key Objectives: Conditioning: Improve endurance, strength, and mobility to prepare your body for more intense training in later phases. Fundamentals: Sharpen basic techniques like footwork, head movement, and punch mechanics to ensure efficiency and control. Discipline & Consistency: Establish a solid training routine and mindset to maintain focus and long-term progress. This phase is essential for injury prevention, skill refinement, and overall performance development before moving into more specialized training. KO BOXING PACKAGE 3
